Stories & ideas, written to be read slowly.

QalamPress is the writing home of Dr. S. Ahmad — psychologist, educationist and author — essays and stories on peace, fear, faith, teaching and the writing life. Membership is free for readers and writers alike.

“Nūn. By the pen and what they write.” — Qur’an 68:1. The pen is where QalamPress takes its name.

SA
Dr. S. Ahmad

Psychologist, educationist, Islamic scholar and author. Nearly thirty years a teacher of mathematics and statistics; writer of Hope for Peace, Overcome Fear, Sakinah and The Crimson Oath.
